findings.text: The docstrings of `notNull_statementKeeps`, `typesFit_statementKeeps` and `checksHold_statementKeeps` omit the quantified assumptions, conclusion and error cases of their propositions. Fix: restate preservation for every clock, parameter list, statement and database, including success, `constraintFail` and the other errors that require nothing.

The docstring of `constraintAtoms_statementKeeps` names its condition but does not restate its assumptions, conclusion or error cases. Fix: state that the four atoms and statement condition imply preservation on success and `constraintFail`, while other errors require nothing.

The docstring of `rowsKeys_rowLocal` omits which effect cases require the atom and which require nothing. Fix: state that success and `constraintFail` require the atom in every table, while other errors require nothing.

The restatement of `TypesFitRunConditions` requires the stored default to fit without stating that `StrictDefaultFitsAt` requires nothing when the target has no table or its table has no rows. Fix: include those exceptions in the restatement.

The three `*ScriptConditions` docstrings and `AtomsScriptConditions` in `ValidAtomsTogether.lean` omit the empty-script, failed-resolution and early-termination cases that require nothing. Fix: describe those cases and state that conditions on the remaining script apply only when execution continues.
